entities.name: Decoded aldehyde substrate
observations: The molecule contains one aryl aldehyde substituent, C4=CC(C=O)=CN=C4, plus methoxy groups and nitrogen heterocycles.

entities.name: NaBH4 NH4Cl reduction
observations: Sodium borohydride in methanol/water with ammonium chloride workup is compatible with reduction of an aldehyde to a primary alcohol.
Dichloromethane is an inert co-solvent; methanol, water, and ammonium chloride provide protonation/workup conditions.

entities.name: Reduced benzyl alcohol product
observations: Predicted major product replaces the aryl aldehyde C=O group with CH2OH while retaining the methoxy groups, heteroaromatic rings, and tertiary amine.
